ShuruaatTa'aruf (Introduction)

Ye document Enterprise ERP ke REST API ka mukammal reference hai. Backend Laravel 13 par bana hai aur authentication Laravel Sanctum ke SPA (stateful cookie) mode se hoti hai. Ye reference seedha code se generate hone wali OpenAPI 3.1 spec (docs/api/openapi.yaml, version 1.0.0) se banaya gaya hai: 314 paths par 533 operations, aur 148 schemas.

Base URL (local)http://localhost:8000/api/v1
Base URL (production example)https://api.example.com/api/v1
CSRF cookie routeGET /sanctum/csrf-cookie — ye /api/v1 se bahar web route hai (local: http://localhost:8000/sanctum/csrf-cookie)
FormatJSON (Accept: application/json); uploads multipart/form-data
AuthSession cookie enterprise-erp-session + X-XSRF-TOKEN header (mutating requests par)
TenantX-Company-Id header (module routes par zaroori)

Is document ko kaise parhein

  • Shuruaat chapters mein woh sab conventions hain jo har endpoint par lagu hote hain (auth, tenancy, permissions, envelope, errors, pagination, money/dates, rate limits, files, versioning). Ye cheezein har endpoint par dobara nahi likhi gayin.
  • Endpoint reference har module (tag) ke liye ek naye page se shuru hota hai: pehle module ka ta'aruf aur overview table, phir har operation ka card.
  • Har card mein: method badge, poora path, summary, Hinglish wazahat, auth/permission/throttle, parameters, request body fields (nested arrays lines[].field ki shakal mein), create endpoints ke liye example JSON, aur responses.
  • Appendix A mein saare object schemas, Appendix B mein enums, aur Appendix C mein permission slug → endpoints index hai. Blue links clickable hain.
  • Kuch responses par shape inferred from code likha hai: ye ad-hoc JSON (reports, dashboards, summaries) hai jiski shape controller code se infer ki gayi hai, is liye kam precise ho sakti hai.

Method colours: GET read · POST create/action · PUT PATCH update · DELETE delete.

ShuruaatAuthentication flow

API Sanctum SPA cookie authentication use karti hai — koi bearer token ya API key nahi hoti, aur kuch bhi secret localStorage mein nahi rakha jata. Browser ko HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax (production mein Secure) session cookie milti hai. Cookie ka naam enterprise-erp-session hai (SESSION_COOKIE se set hota hai; Laravel ka default laravel_session hota). CORS sirf configured frontend origin (FRONTEND_URL) ke liye credentials allow karta hai, aur SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS / SESSION_DOMAIN frontend host se match hone chahiye.

Step 1 — CSRF cookie lein

GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie call karein (ye /api/v1 ke bahar hai). Server XSRF-TOKEN cookie set karta hai. Is cookie ki URL-decoded value har mutating request (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) mein X-XSRF-TOKEN header ke taur par bhejni hoti hai. Axios ye kaam khud karta hai; curl mein haath se karna padta hai.

# cookie jar file: cookies.txt   (Origin/Referer frontend ka hona chahiye — SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS)
curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt \
  -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" \
  http://localhost:8000/sanctum/csrf-cookie

# XSRF-TOKEN cookie ki value nikaal kar URL-decode karein (%3D → =)
XSRF=$(awk '$6=="XSRF-TOKEN"{print $7}' cookies.txt | sed 's/%3D/=/g')

Step 2 — Login

POST /auth/login par email, password (aur optional remember) bhejein, X-XSRF-TOKEN header ke saath. Is route par alag login rate limit hai: 5/minute per email+IP aur 30/minute per IP. Galat email aur galat password dono par ek jaisa message milta hai (account ka wujood zahir nahi hota).

curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt \
  -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" \
  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $XSRF" \
  -d '{"email":"ali.raza@example.com","password":"S3cure-Passw0rd","remember":false}' \
  http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login

Response do mein se ek shape ka hota hai:

  • {"two_factor": false, "session": {...}} — login mukammal; session cookie jar mein aa gayi.
  • {"two_factor": true} — user ka 2FA on hai. User abhi authenticated nahi; session mein ek short-lived challenge rakha gaya hai. Step 3 par jayein.

Tip: har response naya XSRF-TOKEN cookie bhi bhej sakta hai — curl script mein mutating request se pehle $XSRF ko cookie jar se dobara parh lena mehfooz hai.

Step 3 — 2FA challenge (sirf agar two_factor: true)

POST /auth/2fa/challenge par authenticator app ka 6-digit TOTP code ya ek recovery_code bhejein (dono mein se ek zaroori). Recovery codes hashed aur single-use hain. Rate limit: two-factor 5/minute per pending 2FA session.

curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $XSRF" \
  -d '{"code":"123456"}' http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/2fa/challenge

Step 4 — Session bootstrap

GET /auth/session logged-in user, uski company memberships (companies), current_company, active company ke liye permissions (slugs) aur branches deta hai. Frontend isi se menu aur buttons decide karta hai — lekin asal enforcement hamesha server par hota hai.

curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" \
  http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/session

Step 5 — Aage ki requests

  • Har request session cookie bhejti hai (browser mein withCredentials: true).
  • Har mutating request (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) X-XSRF-TOKEN bhi bhejti hai. Token missing/stale ho to 419 auth.csrf.
  • Module routes par X-Company-Id header (agla chapter).
curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" \
  -H "X-Company-Id: 1" "http://localhost:8000/api/v1/invoices?page=1&per_page=25&sort=-invoice_date"

Step 6 — Logout

POST /auth/logout session khatam karta hai aur 204 deta hai. Password change (POST /auth/password) ya reset (POST /auth/reset-password) par user ke baqi saare sessions bhi invalidate ho jate hain. Inactive (deactivated) user agli request par khud logout ho jata hai.

curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt -X POST -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $XSRF" \
  http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/logout

Password confirmation (re-authentication)

Kuch sensitive operations password.confirm middleware ke peeche hain (jaise 2FA recovery codes). In ke liye pichhle 15 minute mein POST /auth/confirm-password ({"password": "..."}) kiya hona chahiye — response mein confirmed_until aata hai. Warna 423 http.423 milta hai.

2FA on/off karna

POST /auth/2fa/enable ek pending secret generate karta hai; 2FA tabhi active hota hai jab POST /auth/2fa/confirm se TOTP code confirm ho jaye. POST /auth/2fa/disable se band hota hai, aur GET /auth/2fa/recovery-codes naye recovery codes banata hai (purane invalid ho jate hain).

ShuruaatTenancy: X-Company-Id

System multi-company hai — companies tenant root hai aur har tenant-owned table mein company_id hota hai. /health*, /auth/* aur /platform/* ke ilawa saare module routes ek company context mein chalte hain. Active company ka id X-Company-Id header mein bhejein.

  1. Server header parhta hai (file downloads jo naye tab mein khulte hain, unke liye company_id query parameter bhi chalta hai).
  2. Verify karta hai ke logged-in user ki us company mein active membership hai.
  3. Agar nahi, to 403 tenant.forbidden.
  • Doosri company ka record id (URL mein) hamesha 404 deta hai — record ka wujood zahir nahi kiya jata.
  • Request body mein doosri company ka id (jaise customer_id, warehouse_id) dena 422 tenant.mismatch deta hai.
  • company_id client se kabhi trust nahi hota — create par server khud context se set karta hai.
  • Branch restriction wale users (branch_ids membership par) sirf apni branches ke records dekhte hain.

Company switch karna

POST /auth/switch-company body {"company_id": 2} ke saath. Server membership verify karta hai aur switch audit log mein jata hai; response mein naya Session aata hai. Is ke baad client har request par naya X-Company-Id bhejta hai.

curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt -H "Accept: application/json" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $XSRF" \
  -d '{"company_id":2}' http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/switch-company

ShuruaatPermissions model

Authorization do layers mein hota hai:

  • Route middleware permission:<slug> — coarse RBAC. Agar route par kai slugs listed hain to koi ek kaafi hai.
  • Policies — fine-grained check (har controller action authorize() call karta hai). Kuch abilities record ke owner / self-service ko bhi allow karti hain.

Permission slugs module.action format mein hain (jaise invoices.approve), roles ke zariye users ko milte hain, aur active company ke hisaab se resolve hote hain. Current user ke slugs GET /auth/session → permissions mein hain.

x-permissions ka matlab

Har operation par spec ka x-permissions route middleware aur policy abilities dono ke slugs list karta hai. Is reference mein card par ye alag dikhaye gaye hain: Route: (middleware slugs, "ya" = koi ek) aur Policy: (policy jo slugs check karti hai), saath mein policy ability (jaise viewAny on Invoice). Agar koi slug nahi, to sirf authentication (ya ownership) kaafi hai. Poora index Appendix C mein hai.

403 vs 404

Surat-e-haalResponse
Permission nahi / policy ne deny kiya403 auth.forbidden
X-Company-Id missing ya membership nahi403 tenant.forbidden
Record doosri company ka hai (URL id)404 not_found (existence disclose nahi hoti)
Body mein doosri company ka id422 tenant.mismatch
Non-platform user platform route par404 not_found

Platform roles (platform.owner, platform.admin) ki company_id NULL hoti hai aur sirf yehi /api/v1/platform/* tak pahunchte hain. Sensitive actions (payroll processing, invoice approval, user management, report export, inventory adjustment, journal posting) audit log mein darj hote hain. UI mein button chhupana kabhi akela check nahi hota.

ShuruaatRequest/response envelope & errors

Success

  • Single resource: { "data": { ... } }
  • List: { "data": [ ... ], "meta": { "pagination": { "page", "per_page", "total", "last_page" } } }
  • Create 201 deta hai (naya record data mein), delete 204 khaali body ke saath.
{
  "data": [ { "id": 41, "number": "INV-000041", "total": "1250.0000", "status": "approved" } ],
  "meta": { "pagination": { "page": 1, "per_page": 25, "total": 1, "last_page": 1 } }
}

Kuch endpoints jo raw paginated collection lautate hain unme Laravel paginator ki links/extra meta keys bhi aa sakti hain; clients ko sirf meta.pagination par bharosa karna chahiye.

Errors

Har error ek hi envelope use karta hai: { "message": string, "code": string, "errors"?: {field: [messages]}, "details"?: object }. message user ko dikhane ke liye safe hai; code stable machine code hai — client logic isi par banayein. Validation errors ke field paths dot notation mein hote hain (jaise lines.0.quantity). debug sirf APP_DEBUG=true par 500 responses mein aata hai, production mein kabhi nahi.

HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Content
{ "message": "Please correct the highlighted fields.", "code": "validation.failed",
  "errors": { "name": ["The name field is required."] } }

Status codes & error codes

HTTPcodeMeaning (spec)Matlab
401auth.unauthenticatedNo/expired session.Session nahi hai ya expire ho gaya — dobara login karein.
403auth.forbiddenMissing permission or policy denied.Permission nahi hai ya policy ne mana kar diya.
403tenant.forbiddenNo X-Company-Id or no active membership in that company.X-Company-Id missing hai ya us company mein active membership nahi.
404not_foundUnknown route/record, other company's record, or platform route for non-platform users.Route/record nahi mila — doosri company ka record bhi 404 deta hai; platform routes non-platform users ke liye bhi 404.
409conflictBusiness-state conflict (e.g. approving a non-pending record).Record ki maujooda state is action ki ijazat nahi deti (jaise non-pending record approve karna).
409finance.period_closed, finance.no_period, finance.immutableLedger refusals.Ledger refusal — period closed, period maujood nahi, ya posted entry immutable hai.
409inventory.insufficient_stockOutbound movement exceeds stock (details has the figures).Outbound movement stock se zyada; details mein figures.
410http.410Expired export file.Export file expire ho chuki — report dobara chalayein.
419auth.csrfCSRF token missing or session expired.CSRF token missing/galat ya session expire.
422validation.failedValidation errors in errors.Validation errors errors object mein (field → messages).
422tenant.mismatchA referenced id belongs to another company.Body mein diya gaya koi id doosri company ka hai.
422finance.unbalancedJournal entry debits ≠ credits.Journal entry ke debits aur credits barabar nahi.
423http.423Password confirmation required.Password confirmation zaroori (POST /auth/confirm-password).
429throttledRate limit hit (Retry-After header).Rate limit hit — Retry-After header dekhein.
500server.errorUnexpected error (no stack traces unless APP_DEBUG).Ghair-mutawaqqa error (APP_DEBUG ke baghair stack trace nahi).

ShuruaatPagination, search, sort, filter

List endpoints (jin ke card par "List params" likha hai) ye standard query parameters lete hain. Ye parameters har card par dobara document nahi kiye gaye — sirf naam diye gaye hain.

ParameterTypeTafseel
pageinteger ≥ 11-based page number (default 1).
per_pageinteger 1–100Page size, 1–100 mein clamp hota hai; default 25 (config/erp.php → pagination.default).
searchstring ≤ 200Case-insensitive substring match; har endpoint ke allow-listed columns card ke note mein ("search matches …") diye gaye hain.
sortstringEndpoint ki allow-list se ek column; - prefix = descending (jaise sort=-created_at). Unknown column default par wapas chala jata hai; primary key tie-breaker ke taur par hamesha lagti hai.
filter[<column>]stringExact match. Kai values: filter[status]=draft,approved ya filter[status][]=draft&filter[status][]=approved (koi bhi match). Booleans true/false.
from / todate YYYY-MM-DDList ke main date column par inclusive range (UTC day start/end). Kaunsa column — card par likha hai.
branch_idintegerJahan supported ho, branch ke hisaab se filter.
GET http://localhost:8000/api/v1/invoices?page=2&per_page=50&search=INV-00&sort=-due_date&filter[status]=approved,partially_paid&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-06-30
X-Company-Id: 1

Selectors ke liye kai modules mein lightweight, bina pagination wale endpoints bhi hain (jaise /branches/all, /customers/all, /suppliers/all, /warehouses/all).

ShuruaatMoney, numbers & dates

  • Money hamesha DECIMAL(18,4) string hai (schema Money, jaise "1250.5000") — kabhi float nahi. Currency document ya company ke ISO-4217 currency code se pata chalti hai.
  • Quantities, rates aur hours bhi exact decimal strings hain (schema Decimal). Request mein decimals string ke taur par bhejein (jaise "quantity": "2.5000") taake float rounding na ho.
  • Timestamps ISO-8601 UTC mein: 2026-10-15T09:30:00.000000Z. Plain dates: YYYY-MM-DD.
  • Company ka timezone sirf display ke liye hai; API hamesha UTC deti/leti hai.

ShuruaatRate limits

LimiterLimitKahan lagta hai
api240 / minute per user (anonymous: per IP)Har route
login5 / minute per email+IP, 30 / minute per IPPOST /auth/login
auth10 / minute per IPForgot/reset password, confirm-password, e-mail verification
two-factor5 / minute per pending 2FA session/auth/2fa/challenge, /auth/2fa/confirm
exports10 / minute per userReport/data exports
search (60,1)60 / minuteGET /search

Limit hit hone par 429 throttled milta hai, Retry-After header ke saath (aur X-RateLimit-Limit / X-RateLimit-Remaining). Har endpoint card par uske limiters "Throttle" row mein likhe hain (spec ka x-throttle).

ShuruaatFile uploads & downloads

Uploads (multipart)

File wale endpoints multipart/form-data lete hain (company logo, employee photo/documents, employment contract, leave attachment, product image, documents aur versions, expense receipt). Server MIME type, extension aur size validate karta hai; allowed types aur max size har card ke body table mein likhe hain (jaise documents: pdf, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, txt — max 10240 KB). Sensitive files private disk par rehti hain. Multipart par bhi X-XSRF-TOKEN aur X-Company-Id zaroori hain.

curl -s -c cookies.txt -b cookies.txt -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Origin: http://localhost:3000" -H "Referer: http://localhost:3000/" \
  -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: $XSRF" -H "X-Company-Id: 1" \
  -F "file=@contract.pdf" -F "title=Signed contract" -F "category=contract" \
  http://localhost:8000/api/v1/employees/7/documents

Note: example ki category value HRDocumentCategory enum (Appendix B) se honi chahiye.

Downloads

Download endpoints file stream karte hain (Content-Disposition: attachment) — policy check ke baad, aur kai audited hain. Agar file naye browser tab mein kholni ho (jahan custom header nahi bhej sakte), to X-Company-Id ki jagah company_id query parameter use karein:

GET http://localhost:8000/api/v1/invoices/41/pdf?company_id=1

Report exports

POST /reports/{key}/export body {"format": "csv" | "xlsx" | "pdf", "params": ...}. Chhota export seedha file (200) deta hai; bada export 202 ke saath ExportJob deta hai — GET /report-exports/{exportJob} se status dekhein aur /download se file lein. Expired export 410 http.410 deta hai.

ShuruaatVersioning

Saare endpoints /api/v1 prefix ke neeche hain (resource-oriented, plural nouns; actions sub-POST ki shakal mein, jaise /invoices/{id}/approve). Is reference mein paths /api/v1 ke baad wale hisse ke saath likhe gaye hain; card header mein poora path dikhaya gaya hai. Breaking changes ek naye version prefix ke saath aayenge; v1 ke andar fields add ho sakte hain, is liye clients ko unknown fields ignore karne chahiye.

Spec code se generate hoti hai (backend/tools/openapi/gen.php): routes, FormRequests, API Resources, Enums aur migrations se. PUT|PATCH ke liye register shuda routes do operations ki shakal mein document hue hain jo ek hi handler share karte hain.

ModuleAuth

Login, 2FA, password management, session bootstrap aur profile/preferences yahan hain. Poora login flow (CSRF cookie → login → 2FA → session) "Shuruaat" chapter mein step-by-step samjhaya gaya hai. In routes ko tenant header ki zaroorat nahi hoti; company badalne ke liye POST /auth/switch-company use karein.

ModulePayroll

Pay components, tax tables, salary structures, employee salaries, payroll runs aur payslips. Payroll run ka status draft → calculated → approved → finalized → paid (ya cancelled) chalta hai, aur har qadam ke liye alag action endpoint hai. Employees apni payslips /my-payslips se dekhte hain.

Spec: Pay components, salary structures, tax tables, payroll runs and payslips. — 38 operations.

ModuleFinance – Ledger

Chart of accounts, financial years/periods, journal entries, tax rates, bank accounts aur ledger reports (trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, general ledger). Debits ≠ credits par 422 finance.unbalanced, aur closed period ya posted entry badalne par 409 finance.period_closed / finance.immutable milta hai.

Spec: Chart of accounts, financial years/periods, journal entries, tax rates, bank accounts, ledger reports. — 42 operations.

ModuleProcurement

Suppliers (contacts, approval, summary), purchase requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipts aur purchase returns, saath mein spend aur supplier-performance reports. Approved requisition se create-purchase-order ke zariye PO banta hai.

ModuleInventory

Products, categories, units of measure, warehouses, storage locations, stock levels/movements, stock receive/issue, adjustments aur transfers. Agar outbound movement available stock se zyada ho to 409 inventory.insufficient_stock milta hai (details mein figures hote hain).

Spec: Products, categories, units, warehouses, locations, stock levels/movements, adjustments, transfers. — 60 operations.
